about: Return skins for the signed-in arrival field (RCS-AUDIO-SKINS-VALUE.md section 2). Each skin is a background family, a filament colour, an ink colour, an optional still set and one C-major voicing. Every colour below is taken from RCS-FIRST-LOGIN-MANAGER.json (synesthesia_palette.key_to_field and colors_hd); no colour is invented. Stills are empty until real photographs are uploaded to the firm's storage and served as /files/{key}. The target roster is 30; recycle after the full rotation.
